name: local-whisper-mcp
description: Transcribes audio files on your computer with Whisper, for Claude. The audio never leaves the machine.

tools.name: transcribe
tools.description: Transcribes an audio file on this computer with Whisper.

tools.name: delete_models
tools.description: Deletes downloaded models to free disk space.

tools.name: status
tools.description: Reports the device, the models, model downloads, and the folders the server may read.

allowed_folders.title: Folders with audio
allowed_folders.description: Folders where Claude may transcribe audio. Leave it empty to allow your whole user folder. Audio that Claude copies from a chat always goes through the server's own inbox folder.

model.title: Whisper model
model.description: Keep "large-v3-turbo-q8_0", the best balance of speed and accuracy. Use "large-v3-turbo-q5_0" if the GPU is short of memory, or "base" on a computer without a GPU. You can also enter any model listed at https://huggingface.co/ggerganov/whisper.cpp/tree/main, by name or by file name. The server downloads it the first time it's used.

language.title: Language
language.description: Leave it empty to detect the language, or enter a code such as "es" or "en".

use_gpu.title: Use the GPU
use_gpu.description: Transcribe on the GPU when there's one that works, which is many times faster. Turn it off to use only the CPU.

idle_minutes.title: Minutes before freeing memory
idle_minutes.description: Minutes without transcriptions before the model leaves memory, including GPU memory, so games and other apps can use it. Enter 0 to free it after every transcription.

auto_download.title: Download models automatically
auto_download.description: Download a missing model from Hugging Face the first time it's needed. Downloading models is the only time the server connects to the internet.
